item.title: After 800 years with one family, 9,500-acre UK estate bought for wildlife with 25,000 donors' help
item.description: The Rothbury Estate in Northumberland has successfully been bought for nature conservation, thanks to the generous contributions of over 25,000 supporters from across 50 countries, amassing nearly £30 million. The Wildlife Trusts and Northumberland Wildlife Trust will oversee restoration efforts, plan a nature corridor, and engage with local farmers to align conservation with farming. This purchase heralds a fresh chapter of conservation initiatives and community involvement.

item.title: High Pollution Alert Issued: Sadiq Khan warns of very high PM2.5; experts seek burn alerts
item.description: London Mayor Sadiq Khan issued a high air pollution alert for the capital urging residents to take precautions. Vulnerable groups were particularly advised to minimize their exposure to polluted air, following high pollution levels. Government monitoring indicated that numerous locations exceeded healthy particulate matter levels due to weather conditions and celebrations. Experts suggested that domestic burning and transportation significantly contribute to air quality issues.

item.title: Iran war, cost of living drag Trump’s approval rating near career low: Survey
item.description: Donald Trump's approval rating stands at 32 per cent, close to his lowest in recent years. Concerns about the cost of living have significantly affected his standing among voters. The Republican Party experienced losses in both chambers of Congress during the midterm elections. Trump has taken action to address immigration, which resonates more positively with his supporters compared to his economic policies.
item.dc:creator: Pranjal Pandey

item.title: Charlie Kirk murder trial set for June 2028 as judge rejects defence's push for 2029
item.description: Tyler Robinson, implicated in the assassination of Charlie Kirk, will begin trial in June 2028. The judge aimed to balance the interests of both the defense and Kirk's widow, Erika Kirk. Prosecutors originally sought an earlier trial start, highlighting the family's desire for swift justice. Robinson's lawyers are preparing a substantial defense, examining extensive evidence and potentially seeking a change of venue.
item.dc:creator: Pranjal Pandey

item.title: Atacama Desert: Where ancient life reveals the secrets of our planet’s beginnings
item.description: In the unforgiving Atacama Desert, ancient stromatolites stand as a testament to early life on Earth and how microbes can adapt to extreme conditions. Researchers are exploring the resilience of microorganisms in this arid environment, revealing insights that might help us understand the possibilities of life on Mars. These findings emphasize how organisms can not only survive but thrive in harsh settings, raising intriguing questions about extraterrestrial existence.
item.dc:creator: TOI Lifestyle Desk

item.title: Turning trash into treasure with oyster recycling: Alabama's oyster shell recycling program supports local fisheries and habitats
item.description: Since 2016, Alabama’s oyster shell recycling program has successfully collected over 31 million shells, contributing to the restoration of an impressive 120.1 acres of oyster habitats in coastal waters. Local restaurants play a key role by properly disposing of their used shells. This initiative not only bolsters marine life and local fisheries but also encourages student involvement in learning about oyster ecology and its vital impact on the ecosystem.
item.dc:creator: TOI Lifestyle Desk

item.title: Psychology says Americans who never leave their home state score slightly higher on psychopathy
item.description: A recent investigation into American adults revealed intriguing links between childhood residence and personality traits. Individuals who remained in their home state exhibited marginally higher scores in psychopathy. This may stem from their stable relationships and self-serving tendencies. Interestingly, those with psychopathic characteristics were more inclined to settle in urban areas experiencing elevated crime rates. Future studies must delve deeper into how mobility influences personality evolution.
item.dc:creator: TOI Lifestyle Desk

item.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang loses $7.4bn in 30 minutes, drops 2 spots in Forbes rich list
item.description: Nvidia's CEO Jensen Huang faced a notable drop in net worth, tumbling from $162.2 billion to $154.7 billion, following revelations of an ongoing investigation into his supposed involvement with a Chinese spy. The resulting unrest caused Nvidia's shares to plunge by more than 7%, raising alarms about its market stability as broader questions emerge regarding Nokia's dealings in China and their national security ramifications.
item.dc:creator: Vijaya Srivastava

item.title: Diwali as US federal holiday? 19 lawmakers back fresh push
item.description: A group of Indian-American lawmakers supports legislation to establish Diwali as a federal holiday in the United States. Congresswoman Grace Meng leads the initiative alongside 14 other representatives advocating for the recognition of Diwali. This legislation aims to promote cultural awareness and inclusion among diverse communities. The festival represents significant values across various religious groups and cultures, uniting people.
item.dc:creator: Vijaya Srivastava

item.title: Asean Faces Funding Gap: ADB says $7.1tn needed by 2040; electricity, transport dominate needs
item.description: By 2040, Southeast Asia will require an astounding $7.1 trillion for infrastructure improvements, with reports indicating a $4 trillion funding shortage. Governments are projected to fund just 45% of the total requirements, making it essential to strategically allocate public funds to draw in private investors. Notable areas of focus include enhancing electricity supplies and upgrading transportation systems throughout the region.
item.dc:creator: Mahima Sharma

item.title: Border Violence Displaces Thousands: over 50,000 flee into Kenya; host families strain to cope
item.description: In recent weeks, a staggering number of over 50,000 individuals have fled from the escalating violence in Ethiopia's Moyale region, sought asylum in Kenya. The humanitarian situation has grown increasingly dire, with urgent needs for food and shelter. The host communities in Kenya are overwhelmed as they attempt to support the influx, which includes a large number of vulnerable women and children.
item.dc:creator: Mahima Sharma

item.title: France blames Iran for cyberattacks on supermarket fridges
item.description: French intelligence agencies have accused Iran's Revolutionary Guards of orchestrating disruptive cyberattacks against commercial refrigerators. The incidents targeted hundreds of supermarkets and other food establishments, resulting in significant disruptions to cold-storage systems. Following these attacks, blood banks were also affected, leading to urgent measures for cold-storage. French officials warned of potential EU sanctions and called for international cooperation on the matter.
item.dc:creator: Pranjal Pandey

item.title: ‘He won two wars’: Donald Trump rallies behind Hegseth amid impeachment push
item.description: US President Donald Trump has expressed strong support for Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth amid impeachment efforts. Republican Representative Thomas Massie has introduced articles of impeachment related to military actions in Iran and Venezuela. Trump criticized Massie's actions and defended Hegseth's record of military achievements and operations. Hegseth has rejected the impeachment charges, claiming they are politically motivated and unfounded.
item.dc:creator: Yashasvi Vasistha

item.title: Defamation Case Moves Ahead: Kai Cenat says lawsuit enters new phase; McDonald’s livestream clash revives RaKai claims
item.description: Kai Cenat has confirmed that his defamation lawsuit against former friend Reggie is moving forward after a McDonald's employee confronted him over allegations involving streamer RaKai. The unexpected exchange happened during his GTA streaming marathon. Kai revealed that his legal team had completed the first stage of the case and was preparing for the next, while expressing frustration over facing the accusations in everyday situations.
item.dc:creator: Global Sports Desk

item.title: Robbie Williams gives his $40 million Florida mansion a rock-star makeover
item.description: Robbie Williams is set to expand his $40 million mansion in Coral Gables, Florida, with a new guest pavilion. The planned construction will include a recording studio and technological upgrades to enhance wellness. Williams made the purchase following the sale of his Beverly Hills estate to rapper Drake for $75 million. The project is expected to add between 2,500 and 3,500 square feet of space.
item.dc:creator: TOI Lifestyle Desk

item.title: Paris Hilton's former Beverly Park home seeks $159,000 a month in rent
item.description: Paris Hilton and Carter Reum have listed their former rental mansion in Beverly Park at $159,000 per month. They previously leased the property for $160,000 monthly while raising their two children. After moving into a larger estate, they opted to stay in the exclusive Beverly Park community. The mansion features an Olympic-size pool, tennis court, and ample parking space. Hilton and Reum appreciate the neighborhood's security and spacious environment.
item.dc:creator: TOI Lifestyle Desk
